ember: Deal ruby damage and inflict lvl ongoing ruby damage, stacking for the remainder of combat.
leer: The target gets -2*lvl melee resistance for the remainder of combat.
astonish: Deal ruby damage and break the target's concentration.
night slash: Deal onyx damage as if 1 lvl higher.
ephemeral guard: You gain 8*lvl DoT resistance for 1 round.
solar blade: Choose the target, then this power does nothing for 1 round. Then, deal double emerald damage. While in sunlight, this effect occurs immediately instead. While in darkness, this effect just deals emerald damage instead.
shadow claw: Deal ruby damage as if 1 lvl higher.
clear smog: Deal emerald damage and remove all temporary effects and conditions affecting the target, whether positive or negative.
fire spin: Deal ruby damage and inflict 2*lvl ongoing ruby damage, stacking until the target passes a passive save.
will-o-wisp: Inflict 2*lvl ongoing ruby damage, stacking for the remainder of combat on the target.
night shade: Deal ruby damage, but use the average damage instead of rolling.
flame charge: Deal ruby damage and gain lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
incinerate: Deal ruby damage and the target drops any items they are holding in a space lvl spaces in a random direction.
swords dance: You gain +4*lvl melee damage for the remainder of combat.
ally switch: Immediately swap spaces with a willing ally within lvl spaces of you.
bitter blade: Deal ruby damage and heal lvl HP.
psycho cut: Deal amethyst damage as if 1 lvl higher.
flare blitz: Cure yourself of the debilitated condition and deal double ruby damage. Then, lose 3*lvl HP.
sunny day: For the remainder of combat, a 60' radius sphere of sunlight radiates from your current space. Ruby damage and the damage of fiends is doubled in the area.
defence curl: You gain +4*lvl melee resistance for the remainder of combat.
rollout: Deal diamond damage, and you can only use this power for the remainder of combat. This damage is doubled for each previous time you have used this power this combat.
bulldoze: Deal garnet damage and the target gets -lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
taunt: The target can only use its action to make damaging attacks until it passes a passive save with a -lvl penalty.
rapid spin: Destroy any persistent zones affecting your space and deal opal damage.
brick break: Deal citrine damage, which cannot be Weak.
stomping tantrum: Deal garnet damage. If your last flare this combat was Weak or Nullified, this damage is doubled.
knock off: Deal onyx damage and the target drops any items they are holding in a space lvl spaces in a random direction.
giga impact: Deal double opal damage and your next flare this combat does nothing.
close combat: Deal triple citrine damage, and you get -lvl resistance for the remainder of combat.
endeavour: If the target's current HP percentage is higher than yours, reduce it to yours, to a minimum of (100 - lvl*10)%.
head smash: Deal triple diamond damage and lose 3*lvl HP.
headlong rush: Deal triple garnet damage, and you get -lvl resistance for the remainder of combat.
protect: You have a lvl*10% chance to ignore incoming instances of damage for 1 round. You cannot use this power if you used it in your last flare this combat.
dragon tail: Deal quartz damage and the target immediately swaps spaces with a random other foe within lvl spaces of it.
roost: If you are standing on the ground, you heal 3*lvl HP.
bite: Deal onyx damage and break the target's concentration.
dragon breath: Deal quartz damage and the target gets -0.25*lvl to all defences for the remainder of combat.
fly: You immediately start hovering such that your minimum height becomes 30' until either the combat ends or your next flare, which is replaced with this hovering effect ending and dealing double pearl damage.
headbutt: Deal opal damage and break the target's concentration.
scary face: The target gets -2*lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
crunch: Deal onyx damage and give the target -lvl melee resistance for the remainder of combat.
zen headbutt: Deal amethyst damage and break the target's concentration.
focus energy: Gain +2 critical success range for the remainder of combat.
double-edge: Deal triple opal damage and then lose 3*lvl HP.
charge: The next instance of topaz damage you deal this combat is doubled. Additionally, you gain +2*lvl ranged/area resistance for the remainder of combat.
thunder wave: The target gets -0.5*lvl to all defences for the remainder of combat.
spark: Deal topaz damage and the target gets -0.25*lvl to all defences for the remainder of combat.
agility: Gain 2*lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
wild charge: Deal triple topaz damage and then lose 3*lvl HP.
thrash: Deal double opal damage, and you can only use this power for the remainder of combat. At the end of combat, become confused until you take a rest.
mud-slap: Deal garnet damage and give the target -0.5*lvl to all attack rolls for the remainder of combat.
hone claws: Gain +2*lvl melee damage and +0.5*lvl to all attack rolls for the remainder of combat.
horn drill: Roll a d100 and add the target's CR. If the result is less than 2*lvl, the target is reduced to 0 HP.
metal claw: Deal amethyst damage and gain +2*lvl melee damage for the remainder of combat.
sandstorm: For the remainder of combat, a 60' radius sphere of sandstorm emanates from your current space. Bright light in this area is reduced to dim light and sunlight is blocked. The area counts as a persistent zone that deals lvl true damage to all foes other than aberrations, giants, and plants.
crush claw: Deal opal damage and the target gets -lvl melee resistance for the remainder of combat.
rock slide: Deal diamond damage and break the target's concentration.
dig: If you are standing on the ground, you immediately burrow through it such that you are submerged beneath it until either the combat ends or your next flare (you can't willingly emerge until one of these things happen), which is replaced with this burrow effect ending and dealing double garnet damage.
drill run: Deal garnet damage as if 1 lvl higher.
confusion: Deal amethyst damage and the target is confused until it passes a passive save.
hypnosis: The target is knocked unconscious for the remainder of combat, or until it takes damage or is shaken awake as an action. If it is awoken by damage, it takes 4*lvl additional damage.
ancient power: Deal diamond damage and gain +lvl resistance for the remainder of combat.
freezing glare: Deal amethyst damage and give the target -0.5*lvl to all attack rolls until it passes a passive save.
dream eater: If the target is unconcscious, deal double amethyst damage and heal 2*lvl HP.
hurricane: Deal pearl damage and the target is confused until it passes a passive save. If used while outdoors but not in sunlight, this damage is doubled. If used in sunlight, this damage is halved.
double team: You gain +lvl to all defences for the remainder of combat.
future sight: Do nothing. In 2 rounds, deal triple amethyst damage.
trick room: Immediately reverse the initiative order, and then move yourself lvl positions up the track. Any movements remaining once you reach the top of the track grant you +1 damage for the remainder of combat.
quiver dance: You gain +2*lvl ranged/area resistance and +lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
mega drain: Deal emerald damage and heal lvl HP.
poison powder: Inflict 2*lvl ongoing emerald damage, stacking for the remainder of combat on the target.
stun spore: The target gets -0.5*lvl to all defences for the remainder of combat.
toxic: Inflict lvl ongoing emerald damage, stacking for the remainder of combat on the target. This ongoing damage doubles whenever it ticks.
moonblast: Deal amber damage and give the target -2*lvl ranged/area damage for the remainder of combat.
grassy terrain: The ground within 60' of you becomes grassy for the remainder of combat. Allies standing on the grass gain lvl passive regeneration.
moonlight: While you don't have line of sight to the sky during daybreak, heal lvl HP. While you do, heal 2*lvl HP. During nightfall, double these healing amounts.
petal dance: Deal double emerald damage, and you can only use this power for the remainder of combat. At the end of combat, become confused until you take a rest.
growth: Gain +4*lvl ranged/area damage for the remainder of combat.
acid: Deal emerald damage and give the target -lvl melee resistance for the remainder of combat.
sweet scent: If you are indoors, give the target -0.5*lvl to all defences for the remainder of combat.
swift: Deal opal damage. This power doesn't need line of sight to the target.
brine: Deal lapis damage. This damage is doubled if the target is bloodied.
light screen: You and your allies within 60' of you have +2*lvl ranged/area resistance for the remainder of combat.
psychic: Deal amethyst damage and the target gets -lvl ranged/area resistance for the remainder of combat.
surf: Deal lapis damage. This damage is doubled if the target is in water.
cosmic power: You gain +2*lvl resistance for the remainder of combat.
confuse ray: The target is confused until it passes a passive save, which has a lvl penalty.
wide guard: You have a lvl*10% chance to ignore incoming instances of area damage for 1 round.
powder snow: Deal sapphire damage and the target gets -0.5*lvl to all attack rolls until it passes a passive save.
curse: For the remainder of combat, you deal -2*lvl ranged/area damage and gain +6*lvl melee resistance.
icy wind: Deal sapphire damage and the target deals -lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
avalanche: In 1 round, deal double sapphire damage. If you took damage during that round, this damage is doubled.
stone edge: Deal diamond damage as if 1 lvl higher.
mountain gale: Deal sapphire damage and break the target's concentration.
disable: The target cannot use the last power it used this combat until it passes a passive save, which has a lvl penalty.
fury cutter: Deal pearl damage. This damage is doubled for each time you have previously used this power this combat.
electric terrain: The ground within 60' of you hums with static electricity for the remainder of combat. Allies standing on the static ground cannot be unconscious while above 0 HP, and gain 0.5*lvl resistance.
feint: Deal opal damage. This damage does nothing when Strong, halved when Normal, deals double when Weak (ignoring the effects of Weak), and deals quadruple when Nullified.
leaf blade: Deal emerald damage as if 1 lvl higher.
destiny bond: If you go down in the next round, the creature responsible for the damage that brought you to 0 HP takes octuple true damage. You cannot use this power if you used it in your last flare this combat.
quick guard: You have a lvl*10% chance to ignore incoming instances of damage from creatures ahead of you in the initiative tracker for 1 round.
copycat: Copy the effects of the last standard action used against any target within 60'. If it deals damage, increase that damage by lvl.
low kick: Deal citrine damage. This is doubled if the target is at Large or bigger.
payback: Deal onyx damage. This is doubled if the target is ahead of you in the initiative tracker.
air slash: Deal pearl damage and break the target's concentration.
throat chop: Deal onyx damage and the target is silenced for the remainder of combat.
brave bird: Deal triple pearl damage and lose 3*lvl HP.
magnet rise: You levitate 5*lvl feet off the ground for the remainder of combat.
toxic spikes: You lay a 10'x10' persistent zone beneath the target that lasts for the remainder of combat. This zone deals 0.5*lvl ongoing emerald damage, stacking for the remainder of combat. This ongoing damage doubles whenever it ticks.
self-destruct: Deal sextuple opal damage and immediately drop to 0 HP.
bug bite: Deal pearl damage and roll a d4, gaining the following benefit: +1 to attack rolls for the remainder of combat, heal lvl HP, +1 damage for the remainder of combat, +1 to all defences for the remainder of combat.
heavy slam: Deal amethyst damage. This is doubled if the target is smaller than you.
spikes: You lay a 10'x10' persistent zone beneath the target that lasts for the remainder of combat. This zone deals garnet damage.
gyro ball: Deal amethyst damage. This is doubled if the target is ahead of you in the initiative tracker.
grudge: If you go down in the next round, the creature responsible for the damage that brought you to 0 HP gets -7*lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
sand attack: The target gets -lvl to attack rolls for the remainder of combat.
mind reader: You do not need line of sight to the target for your attacks and you have +0.5*lvl to attack rolls against them for the remainder of combat.
shadow ball: Deal ruby damage and the target gets -lvl ranged/area resistance for the remainder of combat.
phantom force: You immediately swap between the Material and Ethereal planes until either the combat ends or your next flare (you can't willingly return to your original plane until these things happen), which is replaced with you swapping back and dealing double ruby damage.
triple kick: Deal half citrine damage, then this power has a 50% chance to occur again with double the damage of its previous instance within the same flare. It can occur a maximum of three times.
lunge: Deal pearl damage and the target gets -2*lvl melee damage for the remainder of combat.
bounce: Deal pearl damage and the target gets -0.25*lvl to all defences for the remainder of combat.
speed swap: Swap positions on the initiative tracker with the target, gaining 0.25*lvl damage for the remainder of combat for each space your position changed by.
bug buzz: Deal pearl damage and the target gets -lvl ranged/area resistance for the remainder of combat.
high jump kick: Deal double citrine damage. If the Effectiveness is not Normal or better, you lose 3*lvl HP.
hammer arm: Deal triple citrine damage and get -lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
fire fang: Inflict lvl ongoing ruby damage, stacking for the remainder of combat on the target and break its concentration.
uproar: Deal opal damage, and you can only use this power for the remainder of combat. Additionally, for the remainder of combat, creatures are immune to being unconscious while above 0 HP.
belly drum: Lose 3*lvl HP and gain 6*lvl melee damage for the remainder of combat.
superpower: Deal triple citrine damage and get -2*lvl melee resistance for the remainder of combat.
roar: The target immediately swaps spaces with a random other foe within lvl spaces of it, then gets -0.5*lvl resistance for the remainder of combat.
charm: The target gets -4*lvl melee damage for the remainder of combat.
conversion 1.0: Deal damage of the type of another power on this crystal (if you choose a power that deals no damage, or this crystal has no other powers, it defaults to opal). If it deals Strong damage you gain lvl damage and lvl resistance until you use this power again.
recycle: Roll a d100 to attempt to recover a fully-exhausted cooldown. If the result is less than lvl, you can recover any cooldown. If less than 2*lvl, you can recover any non-LR cooldown. If less than 3*lvl, you can recover any per combat cooldown.
conversion 2.0: Deal damage of a type Strong against the target, and gain lvl resistance to the type of the last damaging power it used.
tri attack: Deal opal damage and roll a d3 to determine an additional effect: 1. the target gets -0.25*lvl to all defences for the remainder of combat; 2. the target gets -0.5*lvl to all attack rolls until it passes a passive save; 3. inflict lvl ongoing ruby damage, stacking for the remainder of combat
fake out: Deal opal damage and move up 1 space in the initiative tracker. If you end up ahead of the target, break their concentration.
force palm: Deal citrine damage and the target gets -0.25*lvl to all defences for the remainder of combat.
bulk up: Gain 2*lvl melee damage and resistance for the remainder of combat.
seismic toss: Deal citrine damage, but use the average damage instead of rolling.
focus punch: This flare does nothing immediately, but if you reach the end of the next round having not taken damage, deal triple citrine damage.
endure: During the next round, your HP has a minimum value of 2*lvl.
reversal: Deal citrine damage. This damage is doubled while you are bloodied.
infestation: Inflict 2*lvl ongoing pearl damage until the target passes a passive save. While taking this ongoing damage, the target is rooted.
bubble beam: Deal lapis damage and the target gets -lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
aqua ring: Gain 2*lvl passive regeneration for the remainder of combat.
soak: The target's creature type becomes Elemental and it gets -0.5*lvl resistance for the remainder of combat.
entrainment: All of the target's passive traits are replaced with this crystal's passive and it gets -lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
liquidation: Deal lapis damage and the target gets -lvl melee resistance for the remainder of combat.
leech life: Deal pearl damage and heal lvl HP.
mirror coat: Whenever you take ranged/area damage during the next round, the attacker takes double amethyst damage (maximum once per attacker).
leech seed: Inflict lvl ongoing emerald damage, stacking for the remainder of combat. Whenever this ongoing damage ticks, you heal 0.5*lvl HP.
wrap: Inflict 2*lvl ongoing opal damage, stacking until the target passes a passive save. While taking this ongoing damage, the target is rooted.
ingrain: Gain 2*lvl passive regeneration for the remainder of combat. While you have this regeneration, you are rooted and cannot be moved against your will.
amnesia: Gain 4*lvl ranged/area resistance for the remainder of combat.
gastro acid: All of the target's passive traits are nullified and it gets -0.5*lvl damage for the remainder of combat.
stockpile: Gain 2*lvl resistance for the remainder of combat.
spit up: Deal opal damage. This damage is added again for each time your crystal has previously flared this combat.
swallow: Heal 2*lvl HP. This amount is added again for each time your crystal has previously flared this combat.
energy ball: Deal emerald damage and the target gets -lvl ranged/area resistance for the remainder of combat.
play nice: The target gets -2*lvl melee damage for the remainder of combat. This power doesn't require line of sight to the target.
frost breath: Deal sapphire damage. This damage always counts as one Effectiveness tier higher, up to Strong.
slash: Deal opal damage as if 1 lvl higher.
flail: Deal opal damage. This damage is doubled while you are bloodied.
swagger: The target gets +lvl melee damage for the remainder of combat and is confused until it passes a passive save, which has a lvl penalty. Additionally, while confused in this way, it has a lvl penalty to its confusion rolls.
snowscape: For the remainder of combat, a 60' radius sphere of snowstorm emanates from your current space. Bright light in this area is reduced to dim light and sunlight is blocked. Allies and fey in this area gain 2*lvl melee resistance.
rest: You fall unconscious for the remainder of combat, or until you take damage or are shaken awake as an action. Additionally, you heal 6*lvl HP.
life dew: You and allies within 60' of you heal lvl HP.
disarming voice: Deal amber damage. This power doesn't require line of sight to the target.
aromatic mist: An ally within 60' of you gains 4*lvl ranged/area resistance.
heal pulse: An ally within 60' of you heals 3*lvl HP.
calm mind: You gain 2*lvl ranged/area damage and resistance for the remainder of combat.
healing wish: An ally within 60' of you heals 18*lvl HP and you immediately drop to 0 HP.
magic powder: The target's creature type becomes Aberration and it gets -0.5*lvl resistance for the remainder of combat.
metal burst: The creature that last damaged you this combat takes double amethyst damage.
kowtow cleave: Deal onyx damage. This power doesn't require line of sight to the target.
torment: The creature cannot use the same power with its standard action two turns in a row. This effect lasts until it passes a passive save, which has a lvl penalty.
assurance: Deal onyx damage. This damage is doubled if you have taken damage this round.
metal sound: The target gets -2*lvl ranged/area resistance for the remainder of combat.
retaliate: Deal opal damage. This damage is tripled if an ally within 60' has gone down this round.
yawn: Choose the target, and this power does nothing for 1 round. Then, the target falls unconscious for the remainder of combat, or until it takes damage or is shaken awake as an action. If it is awoken by damage, it takes 8*lvl additional damage.
sucker punch: This power can only be used on targets that attacked this round. Deal onyx damage and move up 2 spaces on the initiative tracker.
psyche up: You are cured of all conditions, heal 0.5*lvl HP, and gain the effects of all of the target's passive traits.
wood hammer: Deal triple emerald damage and then lose 3*lvl HP.
gigaton hammer: Deal double amethyst damage. You cannot use this power if you used it in your last flare this combat.
baby-doll eyes: Move up one space in the turn tracker, and the target gets -2*lvl melee damage for the remainder of combat.
covet: Deal opal damage and roll a d4, gaining the following benefit: +1 to attack rolls for the remainder of combat, heal lvl HP, +1 damage for the remainder of combat, +1 to all defences for the remainder of combat.
rock smash: Deal citrine damage and the target gets -lvl melee resistance for the remainder of combat.
draining kiss: Deal amber damage and heal lvl HP.
play rough: Deal amber damage and the target gets -2*lvl melee damage for the remainder of combat.
flatter: The target gets +lvl ranged/area damage for the remainder of combat and is confused until it passes a passive save, which has a lvl penalty. Additionally, while confused in this way, it has a lvl penalty to its confusion rolls.
skitter smack: Deal pearl damage and the target gets -2*lvl ranged/area damage for the remainder of combat.

whirlpool: Deal lapis damage and inflict lvl ongoing opal damage, stacking until the target passes a passive save. While taking this ongoing damage, the target is rooted.
water pulse: Deal lapis damage and the target is confused until it passes a passive save.
dive: If you are in water, you immediately dive such that you are submerged beneath it until either the combat ends or your next flare (you can't willingly emerge until one of these things happen), which is replaced with this submerge effect ending and dealing triple lapis damage.
rain dance: For the remainder of combat, a 60' radius sphere of heavy rain emanates from your current space. Bright light in this area is reduced to dim light and sunlight is blocked. Lapis damage and the damage of elementals is doubled in this area.
take heart: You are cured of all conditions and gain +2*lvl ranged/area resistance for the remainder of combat.
